# MultiDatePick - Full Reference

> MultiDatePick is a Salesforce-native Lightning Web Component suite that drops calendar, scheduling, and resource-booking interfaces into Flows, Lightning Record Pages, App Pages, Home Pages, and Experience Sites with no code. Three components share a configurable base: Date for multi-date selection with ranges and recurring patterns; Date Time for date plus per-date or shared time-slot scheduling with conflict detection; and Booking for resource reservation with capacity tracking, live availability badges, business hours per resource, multi-resource checkboxes, and bulk inline edit mode. The suite ships 65+ configurable properties, six storage shapes (per-date, per-range, per-time-block, parent + sub-blocks, per-resource × date), status-color theming on any picklist, additive-only auto-save, a guided Setup Wizard with JSON import/export and Smart Field Mapping, pre-built configurations, and built-in translations for 9 languages.

---

## MultiDatePick: Salesforce Calendar and Multi-Date Picker (/index.html)

Marketing home page (rebuilt 2026-10-20).

- Problem it solves: standard Salesforce stores one date or one start and end range. MultiDatePick picks many dates, ranges, recurring patterns and per-date times on one calendar and writes the child records.
- Three components in one package: Date (many dates, ranges, recurring patterns, status colors), Date Time (adds a time slot grid and conflict checks), Booking (rooms, equipment or people with availability, capacity and business hours).
- Five views of the same records: Calendar (month), Timeline (resources down, dates across, multi-day bars, drag to reschedule), Week (by hour), Utilization (booked of capacity heatmap), Agenda (next 60 days). Each placement picks its default view and which views users can switch to. Point the resource at User to schedule people.
- Standout features: recurring patterns (week intervals and monthly occurrences), status colors from any picklist, edit mode (status, date, time, resource, delete), capacity badges and conflict detection on save, drag to reschedule, status filter pills, hover popovers, date range consolidation, two-month view, 9 languages, WCAG 2.1 AA with a VPAT 2.5.
- Five record shapes: one per date, one per date range, one per time block, a parent plus sub-blocks for the gaps, one per resource per date block.
- Setup Wizard with Walk me through it (three questions) or Configure all properties; 40+ importable configs in the Config Library; Smart Field Mapping for differently named fields.
- Runs on Screen Flows, Record Pages, App Pages, Home Pages and Experience Cloud sites. Editions: Enterprise, Unlimited, Performance, Developer (Essentials and Professional are not supported).
- Pricing: $20/user/month, one plan with every feature, 30-day free trial, no card required. Coming to the Salesforce AppExchange in 2026.
- Live demo: a public ACME Financial advisor booking site, no login, resets every hour.

## Set Up MultiDatePick in Salesforce: Getting Started (/gettingstarted.html)

Five-step setup guide, one GIF per step. No Apex required.

- Which component: Date for dates only, Date Time for dates plus a time grid and conflict detection, Booking for rooms, equipment or people with availability, capacity and business hours. All three ship in one package, every feature included.
- 1. Install from AppExchange (Get It Now; admins, all users or specific profiles), then check Setup, Installed Packages. Components appear as MultiDatePick - Dates, Dates & Times and Resource Booking.
- 2. Assign a permission set: MultiDatePick - Setup (admins who build configs, includes the Setup Wizard), MultiDatePick - User (everyone who uses the calendars), MultiDatePick - All Access (both). Users also need access to your own objects and fields.
- 3. Build a config in the MultiDatePick Setup Wizard (App Launcher): Walk me through it (three questions) or Configure all properties; steps Name & Type, Object & Fields, Time Fields, Status & Display, Review & Save; every object and field is a dropdown, with a live preview. Existing Configurations tab: Clone and Export. Or import a config from the Config Library through the Import tab; Smart Field Mapping matches object and field names that differ, then Apply & Deploy.
- 4. Lightning pages: drag the component on in Lightning App Builder and set Config Name. Record pages supply the parent record; App, Home and Experience pages also need Static Parent Record Id. Load Existing Dates shows saved dates; saving only adds records.
- 5. Screen Flow: drag the component onto a screen and set Config Name; every checkbox setting comes from the config. Booking saves its own records (bookingSuccessCount, bookingConflictDates); Date outputs selectedDates or selectedDateRangesJson; Date Time outputs selectedDatesWithTimesJson. Parse Date Entries from JSON turns JSON into loopable entries.
- First-run fixes (linked to /troubleshooting.html): no Save button, Flow ignores wizard settings, Booking Configuration Required, red couldn't load its data banner.
- FAQ: no Apex needed; which permission set; why no Save button on App/Home pages; no checkboxes to set in Flow when Config Name is set; moving a config to another org via Export and Import.

## Salesforce Multi-Date & Range Picker LWC | MultiDatePick (/multidatepickdates.html)

The Date component: a no-code multi-date picker and date range picker LWC for Salesforce Screen Flows, Record, App and Home pages and Experience Cloud sites.

- A standard Salesforce Date field holds one date; Date saves every picked date as a related child record, so a record can hold any number of dates, each with its own status.
- Three ways to pick, mixable in one selection: click single dates, drag across days for a range, or Add Recurring Pattern (weekdays, weekends or custom days; every N weeks; 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th or last occurrence in the month; start and end date).
- Record shapes: one record per date (default) or one record per date range when End Date Field API Name is set (Mon to Fri becomes one record). Saving is additive: it never deletes existing records.
- Mapping: Child Object API Name, Date Field API Name, Relationship Field API Name; optional End Date Field, Status Field + Status Colors, Hover Popover Fields, Blocked Dates Object. The Setup Wizard turns every one into a dropdown.
- Features: status colors from any picklist (striped mixed days), two-month view, Edit Mode (change status, move or delete saved dates in bulk), hover popovers, blocked dates from any object, earliest and latest date, Max Dates Allowed, Pre-Selected Dates, Only These Dates Are Selectable, second picklist on save, auto-named records, 9 languages, WCAG 2.1 AA.
- Five views of the same records: Calendar (default), Timeline (a date range draws as one bar; Timeline Window default 14 days), Week (date records in an all-day strip), Utilization (heatmap of records per day), Agenda (next 60 days). Set with View and Available Views.
- Lightning pages: set Config Name. Record pages use the page record as parent; App, Home and Experience pages also need Static Parent Record Id; Experience Cloud should turn on Show In-Component Toast. Show Inline + Show Done Button in Inline Mode folds the calendar to a summary card after Save. Load Existing Dates is on by default; Existing Dates Mode editable or readonly.
- Screen Flow: set Config Name; every checkbox comes from the config. Selected Dates (Output) is a Text collection of ISO dates; with Output Date Ranges as JSON on, Date Ranges JSON (Output) plus the Parse Date Entries from JSON action gives loopable fromDate / toDate entries. Set Parent Record Id to also save records.
- 15 use cases: PTO and vacation requests, on-call rotation, event attendance and RSVP, project milestones, facility blackout dates, content publishing calendar, field service multi-day jobs, training enrollment, subscription renewals, audit and compliance schedules, equipment inspection, real estate showings (read-only public calendar on Experience Cloud), sales territory visits, event venue dates, recurring task due dates.
- Pricing: $20/user/month, 30-day free trial, no card required; Date, Date Time and Booking all included.
- FAQ: can a Salesforce date field hold multiple dates; how to select a date range in an LWC; picking multiple dates in a Screen Flow; recurring dates like every other Monday; a public calendar on Experience Cloud; price.
- Properties reference (#all-properties) lists every property by its App Builder / Flow Builder label with its API name.

## Date Time: Salesforce Date and Time Slot Picker (/multidatepickdatetime.html)

- The MultiDatePick Date Time component (App Builder name "MultiDatePick - Dates & Times") is a calendar time slot picker: users pick many dates on one calendar, then pick times underneath, and save one record per time block to their own Salesforce child object.
- Time Display Mode: grid (clickable slots, drag to select a block) or dropdown (start and end time pickers). Time Interval (Minutes) defaults to 30 (15, 30 or 60 typical). Earliest Time and Latest Time default to 08:00 and 18:00. Enable End Time defaults to on.
- Shared or per-date times: by default one shared grid applies the same hours to every selected date; Allow Different Times Per Date gives every date its own grid or dropdown, grouped by week.
- Conflict detection: Conflict Behavior block (default, taken slots greyed out and unpickable), skip (save the open slots, report the taken ones) or allow (no checking). Conflict Look-Ahead Days defaults to 360.
- Group Time Slots by Period splits the grid into Morning, Afternoon and Evening. Status Field and Status Colors color dates and slots; Status Color Display is grid, calendar or both.
- Consolidate Time Span merges selected slots into one start and end; gaps between slots save as sub-block child records (for example a lunch break). Time Grid Only shows just the grid for one implied date (Time Grid Date, then Time Grid Date Field, then today). Allow Whole-Day (No Times) saves a date with no slots as a whole-day record. Max Time Slots caps total slots per user.
- Views: Calendar (default), Week (bookings drawn as tall as they last), Agenda (next 60 days), Timeline and Utilization; View and Available Views control them.
- Also: recurring patterns, edit mode (change a saved date, time or status, or delete it), hover popover fields, a second picklist, two-month view, blocked dates from any object, auto-named records, an in-component toast for Experience Cloud, 9 languages.
- Records: a child object with a Date field, Start and End Time fields, a lookup to the parent, and optional Status and End Date. Save is additive and never deletes existing records. Load Existing Dates shows what is already booked, editable or read only.
- Placement: record pages need only Config Name; App, Home and Experience Cloud pages also need Static Parent Record Id. In a Screen Flow, set Config Name to the Setup Wizard config and every checkbox comes from the config.
- Flow outputs: Dates With Times JSON (selectedDatesWithTimesJson), Selected Dates (selectedDates), Date Ranges JSON (selectedDateRangesJson) and Sub-Blocks JSON (subBlocksJson). The Parse Date Entries from JSON action turns the JSON into loopable entries with fromDate, toDate, startTime and endTime; or the component saves its own records when the config names a child object.
- Runs in Screen Flows, Lightning Record Pages, App Pages, Home Pages and Experience Cloud sites. Enterprise, Unlimited, Performance and Developer editions. No Apex.
- Pricing: $20/user/month, 30-day free trial, no card required, all three components included.

## Salesforce Booking Calendar & Resource Scheduler (/salesforce-booking-calendar.html)

The Booking component ("MultiDatePick - Resource Booking" in App Builder and Flow Builder): a Salesforce booking calendar and resource scheduler on your own objects.

- Any object can be the resource: rooms, desks, vehicles, equipment, or User for people scheduling. Bookings save as records on your own booking object, linked to the resource and a parent record. No new data model, no Apex.
- Flow: pick a resource, pick one or many dates, click open time slots (any minute interval), Book. Adjacent slots join into one booking; with End Date Field, adjacent dates save as one record.
- Capacity: a Capacity Field on the resource keeps slots open until full, with live booked of capacity badges (e.g. 3/10). Capacity Aggregation: Combined sums several resources; Distinct counts one event across resources once.
- Conflict detection on save. Conflict Behavior: block (default, taken slots cannot be picked), skip (multi-date bookings save the open dates and name the skipped ones), allow. Conflict Look-Ahead Days default 360. Hide Bookings With Status removes e.g. Cancelled from the grid and capacity.
- Multi-resource booking (Allow Booking Multiple Resources), business hours per resource, blocked dates from a closures object (whole or part day, all or one resource), status colors from any picklist, hover fields, inline edit (move, retime, reassign, cancel in bulk), resource picker filter by Checkbox, Picklist, Text, Number or Lookup fields, with , for OR and ; for AND.
- Five views: Calendar (month, status colors), Timeline (resources down, dates across, Day/Week/Month zoom, drag to reschedule), Week (business hours grid), Utilization (booked of capacity heatmap), Agenda (next 60 days). Point the resource at User for a roster, shift grid and team capacity dashboard; Config Library ships Team Capacity Planning and Staff Shift Roster.
- Experience Cloud self-service booking: set Config Name and Static Parent Record Id, Show In-Component Toast, and Selectable Statuses. Site visitors are not licensed users; guest users can read and create.
- Placement: Screen Flows (set Config Name; every checkbox comes from the Setup Wizard config; outputs Successful Bookings Count and Conflict Dates), Record, App and Home pages (App/Home/Experience use Static Parent Record Id), Experience Cloud pages.
- Use cases: conference rooms, training enrollment, desk hoteling, vehicle fleet, therapist sessions, classrooms, coworking, hotel stays, field service technicians, truck dispatch, event venues, studios, sports courts, medical appointments, EV charging bays.
- Specs: Enterprise, Unlimited, Performance and Developer editions; 9 languages; WCAG 2.1 AA; 100+ settings.
- Pricing: $20/user/month, every component and feature, 30-day free trial, no card required. Live demo: a public ACME Financial advisor booking site.

## Config Library - Ready-to-Import JSON Configs | MultiDatePick (/configlibrary.html)

Library of ready-to-import JSON configurations spanning Date, Date Time, and Booking use cases.

- ready-to-import configurations covering 45+ real-world scheduling scenarios across Date, Date Time, and Booking.
- A 3-question Q&A filter (the same questions the in-org Setup Wizard asks) narrows the library by time needs, resource picker, and date consolidation.
- Each config card has Copy JSON and Copy Flow XML buttons for either pasting into the Setup Wizard's Import tab or deploying a starter Screen Flow.
- Sample configs target the bundled demo objects (Schedule__c, Event__c, Resource__c); Smart Field Mapping in the wizard remaps to the customer's own object/field names before deploy.
- Configs include Employee Time-Off Request, Facility Blackout Dates, Student Absence Tracking, Court & Hearing Dates, plus DateTime and Booking variants for interviews, room booking, hot-desk hoteling, fleet reservation, and more.
- Shape badges (per-date, per-range, per-block, multi-resource, parent-subblock) tag each config so admins see the underlying record shape at a glance.
- No CLI, code, or XML editing required: wizard import handles the metadata deploy.

## App, Home, Experience Pages - Static Record Id | MultiDatePick (/home-app-experience.html)

Guide to placing MultiDatePick on App Pages, Home Pages, and Experience Sites using the Static Record Id property.

- App Pages, Home Pages, and Experience Sites have no automatic recordId, so the Static Record Id property points the calendar at a specific parent record.
- The Save button appears only when all four are configured: parent record context (recordId, or Static Parent Record Id), Child Object API Name, Date Field API Name, and Relationship Field API Name. A Config Name from the Setup Wizard can supply the last three.
- App Pages and Home Pages are built in Lightning App Builder; Experience Site placement uses Experience Builder with the component under Custom Components.
- Experience Site users need the MultiDatePick permission set plus a sharing rule so site members or guest users can read/create the underlying records.
- Static Record Id points everyone at the same parent (public booking page, one org-wide calendar, fixed dashboard anchor). When the parent is chosen at runtime (per user via Get Records on $User.Id, a ?id= URL parameter, or pick-first), drive it from a Screen Flow. On guest sites $User does not apply: use Static Record Id or a URL parameter.
- Six common patterns: internal booking hub, customer self-service scheduling, personal availability / time off, event and cohort registration, volunteer and shift sign-up, and project milestones.
- Existing Dates Mode (preloadMode) = readonly turns a Home Page widget into a read-only 'what's scheduled' view.

## Salesforce Flow Cheat Sheet | MultiDatePick (/flowcheatsheet.html)

Step-by-step guide to using MultiDatePick in a Salesforce Screen Flow. No Apex to write.

- Builds a gym equipment booking Screen Flow with the Booking component: create a Screen Flow, add a Screen, drag in the Booking component, point it at the resource and booking objects, turn on capacity and conflict detection, and test it in Flow Builder Debug with nothing to deploy.
- The Booking component saves its own records, so a Booking flow needs no loop and no record-create elements.
- Dates and Date Time flows receive the selection as JSON. Three ready-made pieces ship with the package and appear in Flow Builder like standard actions: the "Parse Date Entries from JSON" action (MultiDatePickParser), which returns a MultiDatePickEntryCollection to loop, and the MultiDatePickEntry type for each date. All clicks, no code.
- The Setup Wizard can fill in every property, and every Config Library config can be copied as a ready-made Screen Flow (Copy Flow XML) and deployed with the Salesforce CLI.
- Flows require the MultiDatePick managed package in the target org.

## Accessibility - VPAT 2.5 Conformance Report | MultiDatePick (/accessibility.html)

VPAT 2.5 self-attested conformance report against WCAG 2.1 A/AA, Revised Section 508, and EN 301 549.

- Self-attested VPAT 2.5 conformance for WCAG 2.1 Levels A and AA, Revised Section 508, and EN 301 549 V3.2.1, last verified 2026-05-31 against the managed package (mdpick namespace).
- Evaluation methods include automated @axe-core/playwright 4.11 scans plus manual ARIA, keyboard, and color-contrast review across all three wrapper components.
- Zero axe-core violations found across multiDatePickDates, multiDatePickDateTime, and multiDatePickBooking on both unpackaged source and the managed-package install.
- Calendar uses semantic ARIA grid markup (role=grid, row, gridcell, columnheader) with aria-selected on cells and full date+state in each accessible name.
- All interactive elements are keyboard-reachable: arrow keys navigate the grid, Tab moves between regions, Enter/Space activates, Escape closes modals.
- Color is never the sole indicator: selected dates show colored fill plus bold border; conflicting slots show diagonal stripes plus status badge.
- WCAG 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) and 1.4.10 Reflow are marked Partially Supports because admin-configurable status colors and 320px reflow can deviate from defaults.
- Supports 9 languages honoring the user's Salesforce Locale; supports browser zoom to 200% and user-applied text spacing overrides.

## Salesforce Campaign Dates: Every Event Day, No Apex (/blog/salesforce-campaign-multiple-dates.html)

Blog post (2026-10-19) on tracking many dates on a Salesforce Campaign with the MultiDatePick Dates component.

- Campaigns need no Campaign-specific code: the Dates (or Date Time) component is object-agnostic and saves each picked date as a child record with a lookup to the Campaign.
- Setup: 1) create a custom child object (e.g. Campaign Date) with a Lookup to Campaign, a Date field and optionally a Status picklist and detail fields; 2) configure the Dates component in the Setup Wizard and save a config; 3) add 'MultiDatePick - Dates' to the Campaign Lightning record page and set Config Name.
- Features shown: status colors with status filter pills, hover popover of the record, recurring patterns, edit mode (change status, move date, delete several at once).
- Flow: set Config Name; pass the Campaign Id into Parent Record Id for Click to Save, or loop the selectedDates output.
- Use cases: multi-day events, roadshows and tours, webinar series, volunteer days, send schedules, blackout dates via Blocked Dates.

## Salesforce Utilization Heatmap: See Who Is Overbooked (/blog/salesforce-utilization-heatmap.html)

Blog post (2026-10-13) on the Utilization view of the MultiDatePick Booking component.

- Each resource (room, person, vehicle or any object, including User) is a row and each day a cell showing bookings against that resource's capacity, written like 3/4; the fuller the day, the darker the blue.
- A day booked past capacity gets an orange ring; values are never capped at full.
- A combined availability row shows the whole group's fill per day as a percentage, and a right-hand column gives each resource's monthly average and how many places are open from today.
- Without a capacity field the cells show a plain booking count on the same scale, with a note under the grid.
- A multi-day booking counts on every day it covers, so capacity can mean engagements, jobs or courses a resource carries at once.
- Clicking a booked cell opens that resource's week on that day. Utilization itself is read only.
- Settings: view or availableViews (utilization), capacityField, maxViewResources (busiest rows first), resourceViewFilter, and the status pills, which filter what is counted.
- Use cases: team capacity planning on User, conference and training rooms, consultants and advisors, clinic providers, equipment and fleet, events and classes.

---

## The Salesforce Timeline View: Every Resource and Booking on One Screen (/blog/salesforce-timeline-view.html)

Blog post (2026-10-12) on the Timeline view of the MultiDatePick Booking component.

- Resources (rooms, people, equipment, projects; any object including User) are rows, dates run across, and each booking is one bar as long as the booking.
- Overlapping bookings stack into lanes; a busy day collapses to a count that expands in place.
- A capacity strip shows how full each day is against the resources' combined capacity; Group Timeline By puts rows under picklist or lookup headings, each with its own strip.
- Day, Week and Month zoom; Day zoom shows hours and needs bookings with start and end times.
- With Edit Mode on, drag a bar to move it or an edge to stretch it; it saves on release. In Day zoom the same gestures change start and end times.
- Drag across empty days on a row to select them and book; the row picks the resource.
- Settings: view, timelineZoom, timelineWindowDays, timelineGroupByField, maxViewResources, resourceViewFilter, capacityField, enableEditMode.

## An Accessible Salesforce Calendar for Government Teams (/blog/salesforce-section-508-government-calendar.html)

Blog post (2026-10-11) for state, local and federal agencies running scheduling on Salesforce.

- ADA Title II web rule: an interim final rule published April 20, 2026 moved compliance to April 26, 2027 for public entities serving 50,000 or more people, and April 26, 2028 for smaller entities and special district governments. The standard remains WCAG 2.1 Level AA.
- Federal agencies follow Section 508, which requires WCAG 2.0 AA; every WCAG 2.0 AA criterion is also part of 2.1 AA.
- Government scheduling on Salesforce includes permit and building inspections, licensing and benefits appointments, park and facility reservations, clinic slots with per-hour capacity, and field staff scheduling.
- Salesforce platform accessibility does not cover a third-party Lightning Web Component, because the component renders its own markup; buyers should request a current VPAT for every AppExchange component.
- MultiDatePick uses the ARIA grid pattern (grid, row, gridcell, columnheader, aria-selected), full keyboard operation (arrow keys, Tab, Enter or Space, Escape, no keyboard traps), accessible names on every cell and button, and role=alert / role=status announcements.
- Automated axe-core scans record zero violations on the Date, Date Time and Booking components; a published VPAT 2.5 covers WCAG 2.1 A and AA, Revised Section 508 and EN 301 549, with Contrast and Reflow marked Partially Supports and the reasons stated.
- MultiDatePick is 100% Salesforce native (no external servers, callouts or subprocessors), passed the Salesforce AppExchange security review, runs in Screen Flows, record pages and Experience Cloud sites for resident self-service, and is configured with a no-code Setup Wizard. Built-in translations cover 9 languages.
- Compared with a standard date field (one date per field), external scheduling tools (data usually stored outside Salesforce) and custom-built LWCs (team owns all accessibility testing), MultiDatePick provides multi-date and resource booking, conflict and capacity checks, in-org data and published accessibility documentation together.

## Salesforce Calendar for Multiple Dates | MultiDatePick (/salesforce-calendar.html)

The main overview of MultiDatePick as a Salesforce calendar.

- Standard Salesforce date fields hold one date or a single start-and-end range; MultiDatePick selects many dates, ranges, recurring patterns, time slots and resource bookings.
- Three components in one package: Dates (many days, ranges, recurring patterns, status colors), Date Time (per-date time slots at 15, 30 or 60 minute intervals) and Booking (resources with capacity tracking, availability and conflict detection).
- Replaces common workarounds: child objects with an "add another" button, junction records typed one date at a time, or a custom LWC a developer must maintain.
- Native, no code, configured with a Setup Wizard; works in Screen Flows, record pages, app and home pages, and Experience Cloud sites.

## Salesforce Lightning Scheduler alternative: MultiDatePick compared
URL: https://multidatepick.com/salesforce-calendar-vs-lightning-scheduler.html

- Lightning Scheduler is the earlier name of Salesforce Scheduler, Salesforce's appointment scheduling product. It matches a customer to a qualified person at a branch and time.
- Salesforce Scheduler's data model: Service Territory, Work Type Group, Work Type, Service Resource, Service Appointment. Booking runs through Inbound and Outbound flow templates, plus the Inbound New Guest Appointment flow for unauthenticated visitors on an Experience Cloud site.
- Salesforce Scheduler is an extra-cost add-on in Lightning Experience on Enterprise, Performance and Unlimited editions; each service resource needs the Salesforce Scheduler permission set license. Asset Scheduling (rooms and equipment) is a further extra cost. It supports concurrent scheduling and multi-resource appointments with up to five required resources. Source: Salesforce Scheduler Implementation Guide and the Trailhead module Multi-resource, Inbound, and Concurrent Scheduling with Salesforce Scheduler.
- MultiDatePick books appointments, rooms, equipment or people on any standard or custom object, picks many dates, ranges and recurring patterns in one go, shares slots up to a capacity with conflict checks, and shows the same records in five views (Calendar, Timeline, Week, Utilization, Agenda).
- MultiDatePick runs on record pages, App and Home pages, Screen Flows and Experience Cloud sites; Experience Cloud visitors are not licensed users. Setup is a point-and-click Setup Wizard, no Apex.
- MultiDatePick pricing: one plan, $20 per user per month, every feature, 30-day free trial with no card required, no per-record meter.
- Choose Salesforce Scheduler when customers must be matched to staff by skill and branch territory; choose MultiDatePick for booking and multi-date scheduling on your own objects.
- FAQ covers: what Lightning Scheduler is, Lightning Scheduler vs Salesforce Scheduler naming, whether Scheduler costs extra, Scheduler on Experience Cloud, booking rooms and equipment in Salesforce, a Lightning Scheduler alternative for custom objects, and whether the standard Salesforce calendar is a booking tool.

Security and data handling.

- Passed the Salesforce AppExchange Security Review (static and dynamic analysis, access control and sharing enforcement, safe data handling, no hard-coded secrets).

## Tips & How-To | MultiDatePick for Salesforce (/tips.html)

Configuration recipes, no code required.

- Blocking dates and time ranges from a closure object you control; a whole-day closure makes a date unbookable even if it has bookings.
- Capacity and availability with live "X of Y" badges and conflict handling.
- Status colors from your own picklist values, hiding statuses, limiting what users can select, choosing a view, guest-facing pages, permissions and field-level security, and staticRecordId versus Flow record context.
